50 | The Defender | caster | 1 min/lvl | self | U

# Descriptions
@@ 1
Subtracts 5 from elemental attack rolls against the caster, and adds 5 to all
of the caster’s RRs versus spells. If the spells are cast by a Channeling
spell user that is a member of the caster’s current studied faith (see “The
Mask” spell list), the bonuses become +10.
@@ 2
For the duration, the caster receives a special bonus of +15 to any fear RRs.
@@ 3
For the duration, the caster receives a special bonus of +15 to any poison
RRs.
@@ 4
Creates an invisible force shield in front of the caster. This functions as a
normal shield (subtracting 25 from appropriate attacks, etc.), except it does
not occupy a hand. This spell cannot be combined with a real shield.
@@ 5
As Protection I, except the bonuses are +10 and + 15 respectively.
@@ 6
Grants +10 DB versus melee and missile attacks. Not cumulative with Aura or
Blur spells.
@@ 7
Caster can deflect any one missile that passes within 10 feet of him (caster
must be able to see the missile). This causes 100 to be subtracted from the
missile’s attack.
@@ 8
Caster’s clothing is enchanted to protect as AT 3.
@@ 9
Caster can deflect any one melee attack that he can see (and is within range).
This causes 50 to be subtracted from the attack.
@@ 10
As Protection I, except the bonuses are +15 and +20, respectively.
@@ 11
For the duration, the caster gains a bonus of +30 against any attempts by
others to convert him. The same bonus applies to the caster’s RRs vs. spells
of any other religion that attempt to convert or corrupt him.
@@ 12
Caster’s clothing is enchanted to protect as AT 8.
@@ 13
As Deflections I, except affects two missiles.
@@ 14
As Combat Defense I, except the bonus is +15.
@@ 15
As Protection I, except the bonuses are +20 and +30, respectively.
@@ 16
As Bladeturn I, except affects two attacks.
@@ 17
Caster’s clothing is enchanted to protect as AT 12.
@@ 18
Gives the caster a bonus of +20 against any Absolution spells or against any
Black Channel spells. This bonus is cumulative with other protection spells.
@@ 19
As Combat Defense I, except the bonus is +20.
@@ 20
Caster’s clothing is enchanted to protect as AT 20.
@@ 25
As Protection I, except the bonuses are +30 and +50. respectively.
@@ 30
As Combat Defense I, except the bonus is +30.
@@ 50
Caster can use any lower level spell on this list once per round.
